item.title: O Romeo Vs Tu Yaa Main Movie Review And Release Live Updates: Shahid-Triptii Film Surpasses Adarsh-Shanaya Survival Drama
item.description: O Romeo Vs Tu Yaa Main Movie Review, Rating and Release Live Updates: Shahid Kapoor and Triptii Dimri's O' Romeo will be releasing along with Adarsh Gourav and Shanaya Kapoor's Tu Yaa Main on February 13. The former is a gangster drama, based on Hussain Ustara and Sapna Didi; the latter is inspired by The Pool. Early trends suggest O' Romeo will take the lead at the box office, whereas Tu Yaa Main depends heavily on word of mouth.

item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Saturday made a historic landing at the northeast's first emergency landing facility (ELF).

item.title: Priyadarshan To Support Rajpal Yadav With Higher Pay In Next Film Amid Cheque Bounce Case
item.description: Priyadarshan is set to pay Rajpal Yadav more than his usual fee for the upcoming film as a gesture of support during his difficult times. The filmmaker agreed that he knew about the situation long ago and has continued to help him by offering roles in his films.

item.title: Avinash Tiwary Was Apprehensive About O Romeo: Casting Director Mukesh Chhabra | Exclusive
item.description: Randeep Hooda was signed to play the role of Jalal in O' Romeo. However, just before the shoot commenced, the actor backed off due to personal reasons. Avinash Tiwary was cast for the antagonist's role. In an exclusive interview with Zoom, casting director Mukesh Chhabra explains why.

item.title: Ranveer Singh Don 3 Exit Row Sparks Producers Guild Of India’s Push To Regulate Entourage Costs - All We Know
item.description: Ranveer Singh and Excel Entertainment are reportedly locked in a dispute over the Don 3 actor’s exit from the project. Amid the fallout, the Producers Guild of India is expected to hear both parties later this month. The body is also said to be considering using the case to frame clearer guidelines on entourage costs and related production issues.
